instruction: Access the Drop Shadow filter configuration.

metadata.explanation: This task requires the agent to access the Drop Shadow filter settings in GIMP. The evaluator checks if 'filters-light-shadow-drop-shadow' appears in the GIMP action-history file. The task maintains the same level of complexity as the original - simply accessing a filter dialog through the menu system - but targets a different filter. Verified that filters-light-shadow-drop-shadow is the correct action name for GIMP's Drop Shadow filter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts state by reading GIMP action-history file using get_vm_command_line
Metric check_include_exclude correctly verifies presence of 'filters-light-shadow-drop-shadow' action and absence of error messages
Expected value 'filters-light-shadow-drop-shadow' is the correct GIMP action identifier for Drop Shadow filter
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly (not nested in expected), accesses rules.get('include') and rules.get('exclude') properly
Data flow is sound: command output (file content) flows correctly to metric for string inclusion/exclusion checks
Postconfig properly closes GIMP to ensure clean state after verification
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the single requirement (accessing Drop Shadow filter dialog)
Logic will work correctly at runtime: action-history file is the correct mechanism to verify filter access in GIMP
